title: 第9章林枫的天赋第10章此子狠辣
slug: 莫欺老年穷一天增加一个天赋点
lines: 夜色深沉，陈安靠在门后，平复着体内依旧奔腾不息的狂暴气血。
一百八十八公斤。
这个数字，意味着他不仅踏入了气血关，更是直接超越了寻常趟子手的水准。
“功法是船，根骨是帆。”陈安的眼中闪过一丝明悟，“如今船已造好，想要乘风破浪，还得看帆够不够大！”
他清楚，悟性决定了他能学会什么，而根骨，则决定了他能走多远，以及……走多快！
没有丝毫犹豫，当新一天的子时钟声敲响，那冰冷的机械音在脑海中响起时，陈安的意念果决无比。
“加点，根骨！”
接下来的半个月，陈安的生活极其规律。
卯时，开门。
然后便是去伙房，在柳青月那日渐不善的目光下，端走那一大碗堆得冒尖的肉食。
之后，他便会回到自己的小院，关上门，将整个世界隔绝在外。
《鲸吞功》！
小小的房间内，成了他一个人的道场。
蕴含着庞大能量的肉食，在他一次又一次的功法运转中，被疯狂压榨，尽数转化为最精纯的气血，融入他那干涸了六十年的身躯。
陈安的外表依旧是那个佝偻的老人，但只有陈安自己知晓，自己的体内蕴含着多么强大的一股力量。
半个月后。
演武场上，一声压抑的低吼，骤然打破了操练的节奏。
众人循声望去，只见一个名叫赵武的少年，正是那批新人之一。
他双目赤红，青筋毕露，对着测力铁木桩，用尽全身的力气，悍然轰出一拳！
一声沉闷的巨响。
所有人的目光，都死死地盯住了那根颤动的黄铜指针。
一百五十公斤……一百五十五公斤！
指针剧烈一颤，最终稳稳地停在了那里。
总镖头王铁发出一声赞许的爆喝，脸上满是欣慰。
他大步上前，蒲扇般的大手重重拍在赵武的肩膀上：“不错！半个多月便踏入气血关，虽比不上林枫那等天才，却也算得上勤能补拙！”
说罢，他从怀中取出一个小巧的瓷瓶，倒出一枚通体赤红、散发着淡淡血腥味的丹药。
“此为气血丹，能固本培元，壮大气血，市价五两银子，寻常人家一年都未必能攒下。这是你应得的！”
轰！
五两银子！
一枚丹药！
场下所有新人，都倒吸一口凉气，眼神中充满了羡慕、嫉妒，以及毫不掩饰的渴望。
而那赵武，激动得满脸通红，浑身都在颤抖。
不远处的陈安看着这一幕，淡然一笑。
对于赵武这个孩子，陈安还是有印象的，自从这一批挑选出来的新人入住风云镖局，这个赵武对自己也算恭敬。
所以看着赵武获得了赏赐，陈安心中也只有祝贺。
只不过，此刻的陈安更加在意的还是王铁赏赐赵武的气血丹。
“气血丹么……五两银子一颗。”
他默默盘算着，自己这半个月吃掉的肉食，怕是都比不上一颗气血丹。
这可是专门为气血关乃至是气血狼烟的准武者准备的修行丹药。
一颗就比得上好几天的肉食。
content_en:
The night was dark, Chen An leaned behind the door, calming down the violent energy and blood still flowing in his body.
One hundred and eighty-eight kilograms.
This number means that he has not only entered the Qi and Blood level, but also directly surpassed the level of ordinary thieves.
"The skill is the boat, and the bones are the sails." Chen An's eyes flashed with a hint of understanding, "Now that the boat is built, if you want to ride the wind and waves, you still have to see if the sail is big enough!"
He knows that his understanding determines what he can learn, and his bones determine how far he can go, and... how fast he can go!
Without any hesitation, when the clock struck a new day and the cold mechanical sound sounded in his mind, Chen An's thoughts were extremely decisive.
"Add more, Gen Gu!"
[Ding, root bone +1]
【Root bone: 28】
…
In the next half month, Chen An's life was extremely regular.
At Mao hour, open the door.
Then he went to the kitchen, and under Liu Qingyue's increasingly unfriendly eyes, he took away the large bowl of meat that was piled high on top.
After that, he would return to his small courtyard, close the door, and shut out the whole world.
"Whale Swallowing Skill"!
The small room became his own dojo.
The meat containing huge energy was crazily squeezed by his movements again and again, and was transformed into the purest qi and blood, which was integrated into his body that had been dry for sixty years.
Chen An still looks like the rickety old man, but only Chen An himself knows how powerful his body is.
Half a month later.
On the martial arts field, a suppressed roar suddenly broke the rhythm of the training.
Everyone looked around and saw a young man named Zhao Wu, who was one of the newcomers.
His eyes were red and his veins were exposed. He faced the dynamometer stake and punched out with all his strength!
"Bang!"
A dull bang.
Everyone's eyes were fixed on the trembling brass pointer.
One hundred and fifty kilograms... one hundred and fifty five kilograms!
The pointer trembled violently, and finally stopped there steadily.
"Okay!"
The head escort Wang Tie let out a roar of approval, his face full of relief.
He strode forward and patted Zhao Wu's shoulder heavily with his big palm-like hands: "That's right! He has entered the Qi and Blood Pass in more than half a month. Although he is not as good as a genius like Lin Feng, he can still be regarded as hard work."
After that, he took out a small porcelain bottle from his arms and poured out a red pill that smelled faintly of blood.
"This is a Qi and Blood Pill. It can strengthen the body and strengthen Qi and blood. The market price is five taels of silver, which ordinary people may not be able to save in a year. You deserve this!"
Boom!
Five taels of silver!
A pill!
All the newcomers in the audience took a breath, their eyes filled with envy, jealousy, and unabashed desire.
As for Zhao Wu, his face was red with excitement and his whole body was trembling.
Chen An, who was not far away, looked at this scene and smiled calmly.
Chen An still has an impression of Zhao Wu. Since this batch of selected newcomers moved into Fengyun Escort Bureau, this Zhao Wu is also respectful to him.
So seeing Zhao Wu receiving the reward, Chen An could only congratulate him.
However, at this moment, Chen An was more concerned about the Qi and Blood Pill that Wang Tie gave to Zhao Wu.
"Qi and blood pill...five taels of silver each."
He silently calculated that the meat he had eaten in the past half month was probably not as good as a Qi and Blood Pill.
This is a cultivation elixir specially prepared for quasi-warriors at the Qi and Blood Pass and even the Qi and Blood Langyan.
One grain is as good as several days of meat.
